vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-75593
vulnerability.description: BuildKit: File escape vulnerability allows unauthorized file modification.

statements.impact_statement: Eventrouter does not depend on moby/buildkit: the package appears in neither go.mod nor go.sum, and eventrouter is not a build tool. Scanner matches occur via keyword matching on 'buildkit' keywords in image metadata, not a dependency relationship. Because the component is absent, eventrouter is not affected by any CVE in github.com/moby/buildkit; CVE-2026-75593 is the known instance of this pattern, recorded here as the representative case. Confirmed absent from the manifests both before and after PR #69.
